## Working Group Proposal

**Branch:** `wg/<short-name>` (e.g., `wg/celestial-mechanics`)

**Compare URL:**
```
https://github.com/QSSLibrary/Team/compare/wg/<short-name>?template=wg-proposal.md
```

**Source content template:** `templates/proposal.md`
(use this for the proposal body inside `proposals/`)

---

[One-paragraph summary of the proposed working group]

## Working group details

- **Name:** [WG name]
- **Type:** [leaf / parent / sub]
- **Scope:** [what the WG will and will not do —
  be specific]
- **Initial lead:** [name and GitHub handle]
- **Initial membership:** [list, or "to be
  recruited"]
- **Parent WG (if sub):** [parent WG name]
- **GitHub Project entry:** [link to the entry
  to be created on the WG Operational Health
  project board]

## Motivation

[Why this WG should exist; what work is currently
unowned or under-owned that the WG will take on]

## Overlap analysis

[Overlaps with existing WGs and how boundaries
will be managed. If parent/sub, name the parent
and the sub-scope.]

## Decision authority

Per `governance/working-groups.md` §5.3, working
group formation requires approval by the project
lead (Phase 1) or TSC (Phase 2+).

## Process checklist

- [ ] I followed `templates/proposal.md` for the
      proposal body
- [ ] I have created a GitHub Project entry on
      the WG Operational Health board (for the
      90-day check)
- [ ] I have opened a 7–14 day public comment
      period (GitHub Discussion in the `Team` repo)
- [ ] I have confirmed the proposed WG lead
      accepts the role
- [ ] I have confirmed scope discipline with
      adjacent WGs (joint conversation if overlap)
- [ ] I have included a parent/sub designation
      if applicable

## Related

- Issues: [links]
- Discussions: [links]
- Adjacent WGs: [links to their channels / teams]
